label: Read research paper
description: Inspect, prepare, search, or read cited evidence from one local paper. Prefer search for a specific claim, method, number or section; it uses the local SQLite full-text index without a model or embeddings call. Hits contain matching excerpts; expand with action=chunks, start=chunk_index and offset=match_offset. Search hits are targeted evidence, not full-paper coverage. Prepare only if extraction is incomplete. Requested pages/chunks are returned in full without a separate output-token cap. Follow next_page/next_start and next_offset exactly to avoid overlap. Context management archives content only when needed to fit the model's configured context window; retrieve archived evidence when needed.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local paper document ID returned by search_research_library; do not use an arXiv ID, title, path, or the string "null".
parameter_descriptions.action: inspect for structure/status, prepare for extraction, search for ranked local content matches, pages for cited page slices, or chunks for indexed chunks.
parameter_descriptions.start: For pages, the 1-based page number (0 also means the first page); for chunks, the zero-based chunk offset. Use JSON null for inspect or prepare.
parameter_descriptions.limit: Positive maximum number of pages, chunks, or search hits to return. Choose the range needed for the task.
parameter_descriptions.query: Specific search terms for action=search. Use null for other actions.
parameter_descriptions.offset: Character offset within the first page/chunk, from the preceding next_offset. Use null or 0 for a new range and for inspect, prepare, or search.
